note: Mixed. ORIGINAL (client files: UIResource/UIImage_hd butler_event_name_bN, butler_event_profile_bN and butler_event_text_bN .png; string table 9854-9867): the seven names; each butler's blood type, birthday, keywords and quote (profile, record only: no verified protocol field); the ability names Fishing, collecting Drops and mining; the portrait (art, served unchanged); the outfit item ids (catalog items with art, matched by eye; see each butler's note); gender (read from the portrait, [I]). CHERRY-MADE: the ids (1900000004-1900000010 in the Cherry block; 1900000001-1900000003 were Cherry's Hazel, Wren and Oswin, retired and never reused), the skin codes and skin ids (one default skin per butler: its outfit), skin_color 0 (default tone [I]), the ability-to-gather-kind mapping (Fishing = fish, collecting Drops = essence (the Korean card says essence absorption), mining = ore), free_days, hire (the one 30-day period at 30 earned Cash), and gathering gems, gems_cap and gathers_per_day. Hire prices are in earned Cash (cash). The client's contract picker offers only 30-day periods (CButtonHandler 0x22cfb84), so hire lists the one 30-day period. The free first hire (free_days) is a separate path.
